originalTitle: Inside Chicago's battle against the synthetic drugs flooding the US
summary: The BBC's Quentin Sommerville reports from Chicago, where communities are battling a new wave of synthetic drugs.
content:
Warning: This video contains descriptions of drug-taking and distressing images

A new wave of synthetic drugs is sweeping across the United States, raising fear of a worsening drug crisis.

Earlier this year, President Donald Trump pledged a crackdown on drug cartels, proscribing many as terrorist organisations.

Drug overdose deaths have fallen from a peak of around 110,000 in 2022, down to roughly 70,000 last year.

However, America's decades-long drug crisis may be accelerating and authorities are increasingly concerned about cheaper, more powerful synthetic drugs, including an animal tranquilliser called tranq.

The BBC's Quentin Sommerville reports from the frontlines in South Side, Chicago, where communities are battling the crisis.

Read more about the synthetic drug crisis sweeping the US .
chineseTitle: 芝加哥与泛滥美国的合成毒品的斗争
chineseSummary: 英国广播公司 (BBC) 的昆汀·萨默维尔 (Quentin Sommerville) 在芝加哥报道，那里的社区正在与新一波的合成毒品作斗争。
chineseContent:
警告：该视频包含吸毒描述和令人痛苦的画面

新一波合成毒品正在席卷美国，引发人们对毒品危机恶化的担忧。

今年早些时候，唐纳德·特朗普总统承诺打击贩毒集团，将许多贩毒集团列为恐怖组织予以取缔。

药物过量死亡人数已从 2022 年约 11 万人的峰值下降至去年的约 7 万人。

然而，美国长达数十年的毒品危机可能正在加速，当局越来越担心更便宜、更强大的合成药物，包括一种名为 tranq 的动物镇定剂。

英国广播公司 (BBC) 的昆汀·萨默维尔 (Quentin Sommerville) 在芝加哥南区的前线进行报道，那里的社区正在与危机作斗争。

了解更多有关席卷美国的合成毒品危机的信息。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
